g.text: Partition-function calculations under fixed local budgets
Corrective full-matrix rerun · 828 / 828 planned outcomes retained
Each cell: three status tiles, left to right = stored repeats 0 / 1 / 2. Number below = median fresh-process wall time.
Medians use completed calculations (ok + uv); a partial median shows n/3. — means none completed.
Failures and skips retain their status tiles; their times are excluded from these descriptive medians.
low: 16 MiB table/allocation policy, 128 MiB RSS ceiling, 10 s wall cap | high: 128 MiB table/allocation policy, 512 MiB RSS ceiling, 20 s wall cap
Table policies differ by solver; they are not total-memory guarantees. RSS: 10 ms process-tree samples plus worker lifetime high-water; no instantaneous guarantee.
Wall time includes process startup, JSON loading, solver work and monitoring; offline algebra preparation is excluded. No confidence intervals or significance tests.
Scope: finite-state numerical targets only. Published computational models and synthetic controls are shown separately.
β = 1 is an energy benchmark convention here, not an affinity measurement or a physical-temperature claim. No biological prediction or ETH claim is tested.
